63MOONS.technical: Trading above key moving averages while tracing a double-bottom base targeting the 958.91 neckline. RSI at 69 reflects momentum, but volume lacks explosive institutional confirmation.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite low-base revenue expansion, core operations remain unprofitable with negative trailing net profit (-₹98.8 Cr). Subpar ROE of 4.5% and persistent operating losses fail CANSLIM quality thresholds.
63MOONS.risk: Failure to hold 851.71 invalidates base support, mandating an immediate stop to avoid holding unprofitable speculative paper.

AAATECH.technical: Forming a double-bottom base towards 119.12 above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. Volume is slightly above average (1.22x) with RSI at 59, reflecting modest accumulation without definitive Stage 2 power.
AAATECH.fundamental: Q1 net profit grew just 13% YoY to ₹0.87 Cr on flat 3.4% top-line growth. Modest ROE (10.1%), high P/B (5.1x), and low promoter holding (34.8%) fail CANSLIM earnings acceleration benchmarks.
AAATECH.risk: A breakdown beneath 100.75 compromises pattern integrity; enforce Minervini-style risk cut without delay.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Attempted to break past 114.91 but closed back below the pivot—a classic Jesse Livermore danger signal. Although still above rising moving averages, distribution threatens base structure.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals are severely deteriorating with Q1 net profit down 25.6% YoY to ₹1.02 Cr and quarterly sales sinking 56.3%. Weak 3.1% ROE and poor interest coverage violate CANSLIM standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A drop below 103.84 confirms breakout failure; exit immediately to honor Livermore's rule against bull traps.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Strong Stage 2 uptrend above rising 50, 150, and 200-day moving averages. Executes a constructive '3-up' continuation off the 21-EMA/50-DMA confluence, building high relative strength toward 1003.40.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exceptional earnings acceleration as Q2 consolidated net profit surged 170% YoY to ₹75.4 Cr and revenue climbed 46.8% to ₹610.5 Cr. Robust CDMO demand and API margin expansion confirm genuine institutional quality.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Violation of 921.87 breaches structural 50-DMA support, requiring a disciplined exit to limit capital drawdown.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Textbook Stage 2 advancing profile above rising 50/150/200 DMAs. Pushing against the 477.38 double-bottom neckline on strong 2.21x volume expansion, signaling sustained institutional sponsorship.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Rapidly scaling green utility leader. Q1 FY27 net profit leaped 79.9% YoY to ₹235.3 Cr on 67.8% revenue growth to ₹857.5 Cr. Healthy 34.8% operating margin and high 71.4% promoter stake fulfill CANSLIM criteria.
ACMESOLAR.risk: A break beneath 437.85 invalidates swing support, warranting immediate closure under strict loss-cutting discipline.

ACUTAAS.technical: Elite Stage 2 SEPA breakout to all-time highs above 3513.41, fueled by an extraordinary 12.17x volume thrust. Displays dominant relative strength and clear Darvas box progression well above rising key EMAs.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Market-leading specialty CDMO fundamentals. Q2 FY27 revenue expanded 42.7% YoY to ₹436.9 Cr with PAT up 71.4% to ₹123.1 Cr. Exceptional 40.3% EBITDA margin and semiconductor/battery expansion demonstrate powerful CANSLIM 'N' drivers.
ACUTAAS.risk: A retreat below the 3198.22 breakout base negates upside momentum; exit quickly to protect accrued equity.
